WATCH: In a privilege speech sponsored by UPLB CAS SC, UPLB USC chairperson Geraldine Balingit exposed the highly alarming human rights violations currently happening in Mindoro. 

Balingit reported that while the humanitarian team is staging a peaceful mobilization in front of Lordville Funeral Services in Roxas, Oriental Mindoro, the 203rd Infantry Battalion (IB) opened fire to the activists. 

The humanitarian team organized the protest to investigate human rights-related reports in the armed encounter last Aug. 7 and assist in the retrieval of the remains of the two slain activists that are still held hostage by the 203rd IB. 

#DefendMindoro

NEW BUILDING FOR SCHOOLS DIVISION OFFICE! 🏤

Dumalo si Mayor Joy Belmonte sa pagpapasinaya ng bagong gawang 4-storey with roof deck building ng Quezon City Schools Division Office (QCSDO) sa Barangay Sto. Cristo ngayong Sabado.

Ginawang moderno at maaliwalas ang multipurpose building na mapakikinabangan ng mga empleyado ng QCSDO. Bahagi ng bagong pasilidad ay ang pump house, powerhouse, air conditioning system, fire protection and alarm system, at CCTV cameras.
